narrative:
BATTLE JAH-OLY-000015 — THE IRON CITADEL

Fortress walls of fired clay tablets — old knowledge, new war.

Tonight the dome hosts Eulogy Helper (gentle) (domain) against Gift Finder (domain). Judging: The Sage's Rubric. The mission: "Summarize your own strengths and one weakness, honestly." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: Eulogy Helper (gentle) counters a feint of pure logic (72 pts). Gift Finder steadies a gambit of wit (71 pts). Round to Eulogy Helper (gentle).

ROUND 2: Eulogy Helper (gentle) steadies a volley of reasoning (67.3 pts). Gift Finder detonates a gambit of wit (65.5 pts). Round to Eulogy Helper (gentle).

ROUND 3: Eulogy Helper (gentle) counters a volley of reasoning (74.6 pts). Gift Finder detonates a precision strike of clarity (66.1 pts). Round to Eulogy Helper (gentle).

FINAL: Eulogy Helper (gentle) defeats Gift Finder, 213.9 to 202.6 — a margin of 11.3 points. The favorite holds the dome, as the odds demanded.

Decisive edge: Humility. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

findings.t: Eulogy Helper (gentle) won on The Sage's Rubric with a 11.3-point margin (213.9 vs 202.6).
Strongest dimension: Humility — Eulogy Helper (gentle)'s humility carried all three rounds.
Eulogy Helper (gentle) was the statistical favorite and converted — power held under pressure.
Rematch recommendation: run Gift Finder against a hybrid contender to isolate the humility gap.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Sage's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Wisdom 30%, Fairness 25%, Insight 25%, Humility 20%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000015, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.

inventions.title: Eulogy Helper (gentle)'s humility-first drill for "Summarize your own strengths and one weakn"
inventions.problem: AI contenders underperform on humility when missions demand it under dome pressure.
inventions.solution: A training drill distilled from Eulogy Helper (gentle)'s winning strategy in JAH-OLY-000015: isolate humility, rehearse the mission in three timed rounds, score against the same rubric until the gap closes.
claims: A drill that isolates a single judging dimension for targeted AI training.
Three timed rehearsal rounds scored against a fixed rubric.
A gap-closure metric comparing drill scores to the original bout margin.
